title: Wisdom

questions.question: A good name is better than precious what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:1 (ESV): "A good name is better than precious ointment,"

questions.question: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:2 (ESV): "It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting,"

questions.question: Sorrow is better than laughter, for by sadness of face the heart is made what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:3 (ESV): "for by sadness of face the heart is made glad."

questions.question: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:4 (ESV): "but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth."

questions.question: Better is the end of a thing than its what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:8 (ESV): "Better is the end of a thing than its beginning,"

questions.question: It is better for a man to hear the rebuke of the wise than to hear the song of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:5 (ESV): "than to hear the song of fools."

questions.question: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:6 (ESV): "so is the laughter of the fool;"

questions.question: Surely oppression drives the wise into madness, and a bribe corrupts the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:7 (ESV): "and a bribe corrupts the heart."

questions.question: Be not quick in your spirit to become angry, for anger lodges in the heart of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:9 (ESV): "for anger lodges in the heart of fools."

questions.question: Say not, "Why were the former days better than these?" For it is not from what that you ask this?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:10 (ESV): "For it is not from wisdom that you ask this."

questions.question: Wisdom is good with an inheritance, an advantage to those who notice the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:11 (ESV): "an advantage to those who see the sun."

questions.question: For the protection of wisdom is like the protection of what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:12 (ESV): "For the protection of wisdom is like the protection of money,"

questions.question: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider: God has made the one as well as the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:14 (ESV): "God has made the one as well as the other,"

questions.question: Be not overly righteous, and do not make yourself too wise. Why should you destroy whom?
Be not overly wicked, neither be a fool. Why should you die before your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 7:17 (ESV): "Why should you die before your time?"

key_verse_text: Be not quick in your spirit to become angry, for anger lodges in the heart of fools.
